It then flips to 'Dost ke paiso ka khana' with heart-eye emojis as a second man holds the plate and both eat enthusiastically, exaggerating enjoyment. This bait-and-switch relies on shared cultural understanding among Indian audiences that splitting bills or treating friends changes perception of value, making it situational rather than verbal joke. The exaggerated facial reactions and simple text contrast deliver the punchline without dialogue, fitting typical Instagram Reels relatable-comedy format.
